Getting ready

The day before and moving day

What to prepare the day before, how the day goes, and what to check on arrival before signing.

5 min read · Updated 14 October 2026

Contents

  1. The day before
  2. At departure
  3. On arrival
  4. If something is damaged
  5. FAQ

Need tailored advice?

Home moves

The day before

  • Empty, unplug and defrost the fridge and freezer, door open.
  • Unplug the washing machine and drain it fully.
  • Pack a personal bag: papers, keys, chargers, medicines, jewellery.
  • Clear walkways and gather boxes near the entrance.
  • Tell the caretaker or managing agent, book the lift if possible.
  • Check the parking permit is in place.
  • Arrange care for children and pets.

At departure

  1. Welcome the team and walk through the rooms with the team leader.
  2. Point out fragile items, what stays and what goes into storage.
  3. Stay reachable during loading.
  4. Read the meters, do the move-out inspection, and a final check: cupboards, cellar, balcony.

On arrival

  • Arrive before the team to open up and show the rooms.
  • Have the furniture placed where you want it: easier on the day.
  • Check the furniture and boxes before signing the delivery note.

If something is damaged

If you notice damage on delivery, describe it precisely on the delivery note. If you find it after the team has left, you have 10 days after delivery to report it by registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt. A plain email is not enough.

Cody’s tip

Keep water, snacks and a kitchen roll within reach: it is a long day, for you and for the team.

Frequently asked questions

Should I provide anything for the team?

Nothing compulsory. Clear walkways, a space for the truck and access to water make the day easier.

Do I need to be there all day?

At least at the start of loading and at delivery, you or someone you trust, to give instructions and check your belongings.
